items.Sentence: The treatment system at the Facility consists of bar screening; biological treatment...

biological treatment, including nitrification and denitrification; ...aeration basin structure houses three Bardenpho Process aeration basin trains comprised of an anaerobic zone, several anoxic zones, a swing zone and several aerobic zones
biological treatment, including nitrification and denitrification; alkalinity adjustment; secondary sedimentation
alkalinity adjustment; secondary sedimentation; cloth media filtration

Secondary effluent flows by gravity to the effluent filters where it flows through the polymer mixing zone and flocculation basin, then through the filter media where flocculated particles are removed.
secondary sedimentation; cloth media filtration; and ultraviolet light (UV) disinfection
cloth media filtration; and ultraviolet light (UV) disinfection
A 4-million-gallon emergency retention basin is available for storage of excess influent flow or partially treated wastewater.
Sludge processing consists of aerobic digestion and sludge storage basins.
The sludge storage basins provide storage for stabilized solids during wet weather periods and serve as drying beds during the warm summer months.
The sludge storage basins...serve as drying beds during the warm summer months.
Dried sludge is hauled to the West Central landfill, operated by the City of Redding, for disposal.
